title: 语法填空　语言运用第二节 · 练习
goal: 根据语境和句子结构填写合适的词或词形。

points.label: 依据句法判断谓语或非谓语形式
按句法位置完成词性转换
按句子成分判断无提示词的作用

sources.title: 2024 年高考综合改革适应性测试 英语（新课标卷）试卷（教育部教育考试院）

groups.label: Grammar
groups.text:
Last autumn, our school started a small seed library. Students bring seeds from plants they have grown and exchange them for others. The project (1) _____ (begin) with a box in the science room, but it soon needed more space. A teacher offered a cupboard (2) _____ the boxes could be kept dry.

Each packet has a label with the name of the plant and the date. Students are asked (3) _____ (write) down where they collected the seeds, too. This information is (4) _____ (help) when another student wants to find out how the plant grows. The packets are arranged (5) _____ colour, so visitors can find flowers and vegetables easily.

At the end of each term, volunteers count the packets and check the labels. If a label is missing, they put the packet aside rather than make a guess. Last week, several younger pupils joined the team. They worked (6) _____ (careful) and asked many questions. One pupil said that she had never noticed how different seeds could be in size. Another was surprised that a dry bean could grow into a plant. The library has become a place (7) _____ students share both seeds and experience. It also gives them a reason to return in spring, when the garden (8) _____ (be) ready for planting. Anyone can join, and no one needs to buy (9) _____ expensive tool. All that is required is an interest (10) _____ growing something.

items.why: begin 的过去式与 Last autumn 对应。
先行词 cupboard 表示存放地点，定语从句缺地点状语。
ask someone to do 要求不定式。
is 后用形容词作表语。
by colour 表示按颜色分类。
修饰动词 worked 用副词。
先行词 place 表示地点，定语从句缺地点状语。
从句主语是单数 garden，描述春天的状态用 is。
expensive 以元音音素开头，单数名词前用 an。
an interest in 是固定搭配。

groups.label: Grammar
groups.text:
The town museum recently invited local families to help describe a collection of old photographs. The pictures (1) _____ (show) streets, shops and gardens as they appeared many years ago. Some had dates on the back, while others had no information at all. The museum hoped visitors could help identify the places (2) _____ were shown in them.

On the first Saturday, a volunteer placed the photographs on long tables. Visitors were given pencils and cards on which they could record their ideas. One family recognised a building because a similar picture (3) _____ (hang) in their home. They wrote down its former use as a bakery and explained that the building had later become a post office.

The museum staff did not add every suggestion to the catalogue immediately. They compared the notes with maps and other records before making a decision. This was a slow but (4) _____ (use) process: two streets had once had very similar shop fronts. The team also made digital copies so that the original photographs could be stored (5) _____ (safe).

Next month the museum will hold another meeting. Visitors will be able to see (6) _____ the collection has changed and discuss the questions that remain. The project depends (7) _____ people sharing what they know, but staff are careful to distinguish a memory from a fact supported by several records. For the museum, the photographs are not merely objects in (8) _____ box. They offer a way to connect the history of the town (9) _____ the people who live there now. Volunteers are looking forward to (10) _____ (discover) more about the places in the pictures.

items.why: 复数主语 pictures 搭配一般现在时 show。
先行词 places 指物，在定语从句中作主语。
挂在家中的照片描述过去状态，用 hang 的过去式 hung。
修饰名词 process 用形容词。
修饰 stored 用副词。
how 引导宾语从句，表示藏品发生了怎样的变化。
depend on 和 depend upon 均表示依靠。
box 是首次提及的单数可数名词，前用 a。
connect ... with 或 connect ... to 均可表示连接。
look forward to 中 to 是介词，后接动名词。
